body:
## What & why

Replaces host-executed extension loading with isolated builds, immutable releases, and exact human approval. The SDK, harness, HTTP, runtime, and browser share one contract. A harness can prepare a release but cannot approve it. Activation, invocation, and revocation recheck the exact approved authority.

The final repair also makes the first clean SDK install deterministic and closes invocation authority when a handler ends. Notifications already admitted finish before teardown, including failure paths; late callbacks cannot add new effects, and the original handler error is preserved.

## Feature contract

- [x] New-file coverage: all 131 new source files pass.
- [x] Changed-line coverage: all changed executable lines across 370 files pass.
- [x] Playwright E2E and visual evidence cover the new flows. Final hosted mock, real-auth, and visual checks all pass on the candidate below.
- [ ] Gate migration approval: the same 84 deliberate migration findings require human acceptance. No implementation agent applied an approval label or weakened a gate.
- [x] Final technical CI: all 32 non-policy checks pass on the final candidate.
- [ ] Required human review and migration acceptance remain outstanding.

## Current candidate

**Draft. Do not merge until the migration decision, all project acceptance checks, and required review are complete.**

Final candidate: `2c73e6bac85cd8f288056250ff032f613bfc15cd`.
Git tree: `4a5c5c7a27e8315c25262ecfb3c27db030493388`.
Base: `65edc5bc0e36c6147219631e9cf73f89529bdef3`.

Two additional defects were reproduced and repaired:

- `34affe98`: the first fully clean frozen install exited 2 during SDK preparation because its compiler was not a declared SDK dependency. A direct TypeScript dependency and matching lock entry make the first install pass.
- `2c73e6ba`: a handler failure or first notification failure could end invocation teardown before other admitted effects finished. The channel now closes to new effects when the handler settles and drains every admitted notification. Regression tests and a separate Sol review validate the change.

The prior SSE repair is also verified: line 139 has 14 hits, and the hosted-equivalent artifact merge measures 87/87 covered lines. Hosted run 33985047000 passed all 32 other checks and failed only Gate integrity before these two additional repairs.

## Final local validation

All results below apply to the final candidate tree:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| First root and web frozen installs | Pass |
| Full typecheck | All four lanes pass |
| Lint | Zero errors; 105 existing warnings and 11 informational findings |
| Svelte check | Zero errors; 13 existing warnings |
| Backend wrapper | 24,544 pass; zero fail; 1,559 files |
| Full coverage wrapper | Bun 25,806 pass; Node 4,551 pass; zero fail |
| Per-file coverage | All 1,246 enforced files pass |
| New-file and patch coverage | 131 new files; all changed executable lines across 370 files |
| SDK default suite | 1,025 pass; zero fail; one opt-in container skip |
| Opted-in real rootless MCP | Seven pass; zero fail or skip; 32 assertions |
| Gate integrity | The same 84 migration findings; no new findings |

A separate browser/API review exercised real login, build, exact approval, activation, real invocation, failed-update retention, disable, uninstall, and retained history. It passed the authoring and control E2E flows, 58 Vitest tests, and six Bun test files. Five desktop/mobile screenshots were inspected. These UI/API files are unchanged by the two final SDK repairs; final hosted E2E also passes on the candidate below.

The full earlier architecture evidence, including all 50 first-party isolated builds, the eight production-image lifecycle checks, PostgreSQL transaction/revocation checks, and complete browser suites, remains recorded in `docs/extension-v4-validation.md` and `gates/final-validation.md`. Those documents identify their tested revision; they are not a substitute for current-head CI.

## Final hosted result

[CI run 33986413598](https://github.com/ezcorp-org/EZHarness/actions/runs/33986413598) and its companion audit/PostgreSQL runs are complete on `2c73e6bac85cd8f288056250ff032f613bfc15cd`: 32 checks pass. Gate integrity is the sole failure and reports exactly the same 84 findings as before the repairs. Every branch-protection check passes, but this project acceptance gate and non-author approval remain required. The PR is conflict-free and current with `main`; no review is present.

## Required migration decision

The [numbered migration review](https://github.com/ezcorp-org/EZHarness/blob/feat/extension-v4/src/__tests__/extension-v4-migration-coverage.md) accounts for all 84 findings: one retired threshold, 27 deleted test files, 25 renamed files, and 31 condensed files. A fresh Sol audit verified replacement test behavior and required test/coverage discovery. It found no undisclosed coverage loss or vacuous replacement.

Six deliberate behavior removals still require explicit maintainer acceptance:

1. Automatic development watcher, debounce, reload, and shutdown behavior.
2. Inline visual permission composition and mutable capability toggles.
3. Per-capability TTL and Never renewal issuance.
4. Destructive discard/purge; the replacement retains immutable history and user data.
5. Generic Git import and automatic updates; supported imports are local, GitHub, and marketplace paths.
6. Host lifecycle scripts and unconsumed legacy `subAgents` metadata.

These are product cutovers, not equivalent replacement coverage. A maintainer must review the ledger and apply `gate-change-approved` only if those decisions are accepted. An implementation agent cannot apply it. Protected gate files also require human review, and branch protection requires a non-author approval. No approval or policy bypass has been used.

## Limits

Rootless containers share the host kernel. Explicit trusted-local mode has reduced isolation. Raw-secret access plus approved network egress permits disclosure of that secret. Cancellation and database rollback do not undo an already admitted external effect; unknown external outcomes are not replayed automatically.
